title: [GMCP 203.012.M] Mastery: Subscriptions, notifications, progress, and operational messages
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-012-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: Modern subscriptions/listen filters and acknowledgement metadata work for tools, prompts, resources and resource updates, with bounded fan-out, ordering guarantees, cancellation, reconnect policy, backpressure and authorization re-checks. Progress and operational log notifications correlate to the originating request, obey requested levels and redaction, and never become an unbounded covert channel. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
limitations: Core serves the subscriptions, notifications, progress, and operational messaging surface (`crates/susi-gmcp/src/{protocol,jsonrpc_gate,catalog,server,stdio,mcp/{http,message,model,service,transport}}.rs`) across stdio (`susi mcp serve`), in-process `embedded_adapter`, Streamable HTTP (`/mcp` and `/messages`), and Unix-domain sockets (`#[cfg(unix)]`); Windows x86_64 covers stdio, embedded, and Streamable HTTP while Unix socket parity is gated `#[cfg(unix)]`.

MCP subscription streams remain stateless across transport disconnects (`MCP-2026-0728-basic-patterns-subscriptions-mdx-0161`), requiring clients to re-issue `subscriptions/listen` and refresh state via `*/list` or `resources/read`, and `notifications/message` remains gated on explicit `io.modelcontextprotocol/logLevel` (modern) or negotiated `2025-11-25` adapter `logging/setLevel` within the SEP-2577 deprecation window.

Mastery consumes and verifies retained, signed, non-mock JSONL evidence in `.agents/gmcp/evidence/VC-203-012.jsonl` across `GMCP-203-012-01..06` and `-M` plus `.agents/roadmap.json` and `.agents/roadmap-verdicts/VC-203-012.json`.

reuse.reason: The subscriptions/listen filter & ack routing, cancellation propagation, progress coalescing & duplicate-token rejection, RFC 5424 operational logging with redaction & bounds (16 subscriptions/session, 256 URIs/filter, 64 logs/req, 16 KiB payload, 256 broadcast buffer with -32603 lag cutoff), HTTP/era gates, and test harnesses (`embedded_adapter`, `socket_adapter`, `StdioSession`, `GmcpServer::start_http_server`, `evidence_artifacts`, `newest_records`) already exist in Susi Core; this mastery gate composes and verifies them plus committed VC-203-012 evidence and verdict artifacts without duplicating server logic.
